logsFields.globHelp: A full path, or a glob such as /var/log/system.log*; rotated and compressed files are read too.
logsFields.formatHelp: How each record of the files is written. A line the format cannot read is kept with its raw text and the reason.
logsFields.patternHint: A regular expression; each named group, such as (?P<level>…), is a column.
logsFields.recordStartHelp: What the first line of a record starts with, when a record spans lines; leave empty for one record a line.

formats.aws_alb: AWS Application Load Balancer access log
formats.aws_nlb: AWS Network Load Balancer access log
formats.aws_elb: AWS Classic Load Balancer access log
